title: Topological spectrum of a directed colimit of rings
statement: Let $I$ be a small nonempty directed partially ordered set, let $(A_i,r_{ij}:A_i\to A_j)_{i\le j}$ be a directed system of commutative rings, and let $A=\varinjlim_i A_i$ with coprojections $r_i:A_i\to A$ be its colimit in commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Write $p_{ij}:\operatorname{Spec}A_j\to\operatorname{Spec}A_i$ and $p_i:\operatorname{Spec}A\to\operatorname{Spec}A_i$ for the induced maps [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. The map $\mathfrak p\mapsto(r_i^{-1}\mathfrak p)_i$ is a homeomorphism from $|\operatorname{Spec}A|$ to the set of families of primes $(\mathfrak p_i)_i$ with $r_{ij}^{-1}(\mathfrak p_j)=\mathfrak p_i$ for every $i\le j$, equipped with the coarsest topology making all coordinate projections continuous. Thus $|\operatorname{Spec}A|$ is the inverse limit of the spaces $|\operatorname{Spec}A_i|$. Moreover, for every $i$ and every quasi-compact open $Q\subseteq|\operatorname{Spec}A_i|$, the open subset $p_i^{-1}(Q)$ is quasi-compact.
